resources.name: Forestdale Inc.
resources.mission: Forestdale's (FD) mission is to ensure that children and families have the fundamental assets needed to thrive and live independently. FD exceeds traditional child welfare services by using innovative, evidence-based methods to support low-income families, helping them heal from trauma, empowering parents to raise resilient children, and helping youth transition to adulthood. Key FD programs are preventive services, foster care, adoption, parenting support, youth development, health services, and traumainformed care. In FY24, we worked with 4,000 families, notably impacting the communities where our families live and work.

resources.name: The City Tutors, Inc
resources.mission: The City Tutors is NYC's educational subway: offering free, flexible tutoring and career mentoring built for historically underserved communities and open to all. Available year-round across all five boroughs, The City Tutors help people build skills, grow their networks, and chart their own paths-so they're not limited by where they start and can experience the full promise of what New York has to offer. The City Tutors provides tutoring and mentoring primarily online, making our services accessible citywide year-round. In-person opportunities are also available depending on location and partner site. Organizations or community members interested in partnering with us can schedule a time to talk with a CT staff member here: calendly.com/mchin-5/michael-chin-meeting
resources.fees: Academic Support and Professional Mentorship services are free.
